elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: The clause retains a minimum Monthly Base Fee and requires Customer to obtain all Services included in that fee during the then-current twelve-month period.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: The agreement still requires minimum monthly fees paid in advance, and Estimated Remaining Value remains calculated using minimum fees for the months remaining in the Term.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: Customer's obligation is expressly limited to the “then-current twelve (12) month period of the Term only.”

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Customer may reduce the included Services and corresponding Monthly Base Fee commitment upon thirty days' prior written notice to M&I.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: The added language states that any resulting shortfall is handled solely through a true-up to Services actually ordered and used, and not as a penalty.
